hall-proc: Baseline: flat cream drum, lilac dome, purple band, reads instantly.
hall-tripo-A: Ribbed dome and windows close to the procedural look, a little duller.
hall-tripo-B: Same as A, cleanest window row; the dome loses the procedural lilac glow.
hall-hunyuan-A: Right silhouette, but ragged base and lumpy dome facets.
hall-hunyuan-B: As A; wobbly plinth edge and noisy dome.
cluster-proc: Baseline: chunky cream towers, blue caps, glowing LEDs, spinning fan.
cluster-tripo-A: Recognisable towers and LEDs, less crisp than procedural.
cluster-tripo-B: Most toy-like of all: stacked rack detail, blue base and caps, yellow LED strips.
cluster-hunyuan-A: Pale blue roofs bleed into the walls, no LEDs.
cluster-hunyuan-B: Rack stack collapsed into mush; the detail did not survive.
float-proc: Blockout: readable, but a bottle made of cylinders and black boxes.
float-tripo-A: Bottle, cap, sunglasses, banners and wheels all present and in palette.
float-tripo-B: Best of the float set: label band and sunglasses read, banners in accent colours.
float-trellis-B: Decimation shredded the mesh into spikes; a 486k-tri raw mesh with thin parts does not survive a 5k budget.
